Section: Native structural detachment > Native tree support loss and remaining lifecycle limits
The playable diagnostic starts with actual native RedBrick terrain, an asymmetric crown, two open geometric regions, a cuttable trunk, a floor and an unrelated control structure. A real native cut triggers local support discovery. Exactly 520 eligible cells can become one six-shape Rapier aggregate. This is an explicit local diagnostic trigger, not automatic general gameplay fracture. The tree then falls, rotates and translates through Rapier. Native payloads retain exclusive ownership. Dense-material penetration, general fracture, multiple aggregates, active restoration and normal gameplay remain incomplete; functional support loss alone does not complete #281.

Section: Physics characterisation and soliding plan > Phase 4: reversible soliding > D. Dissolve, fracture and recover
Return to cells when stress, damage, heat, chemistry or fragmentation exceeds policy. Before release, reserve all destination cells and any bounded overflow representation. Never overwrite existing cells. If placement cannot conserve membership, retain the aggregate and report a deferred transition; do not delete or silently truncate it. Rotated rasterization must not duplicate/lose cells. Reconcile momentum explicitly: either support a bounded moving-fragment/particle representation, or restrict demotion to near-rest with documented energy error. Repeated promote/move/rotate/demote cycles must not create mass or energy. Test unsupported collapse, bridges, split/merge, high-speed impacts, clustered barrels, saturated capacity, out-of-order acknowledgements, failed ticks, save/load and offscreen re-entry. Persist membership, representation state, pending handoffs and policy versions in a new schema before claiming continuation. Start with one small coherent material island and one barrel, then scale.

Section: Granular interaction and sampled player policy > How does the sampled character move and recover? > REM-003 sampled-player landing response
**Current candidate C1:** the version-1 8/9 downward and 9/9 side/upward support classification is unchanged. REM-003 source-matched characterization found that packed standing, flat traversal, representative powders and excavation release worked within their registered cases, while materially different Sand landing speeds resolved to nearly the same rigid support height with no granular response. C1 therefore changes the sampled-character response rather than retuning the shared support predicate used by REM-002 generic body bearing. On a downward sampled-player collision, impact speed below 24 cells/second causes no disturbance. From 24 through less than 72, at most one supported foot-edge grain may move; at 72 or above, at most two may move. Only the left/right contact edge is considered. A candidate grain must be a stored support-capable granular material that currently satisfies the existing packing/stability predicate. It may move exactly one cell diagonally outward/up only through the existing whole-cell conservative relocation path into real Empty storage not occupied by another transient body. Material state and temperature move with the cell and the normal wake/dirty machinery runs. Hard terrain anywhere in the sampled collision volume fails this disturbance path closed; liquids, loose/unsupported grains and ordinary resting contact likewise do not trigger it. The player still stops on the accepted support surface; C1 does not introduce character-owned material, a granular Rapier collider, a pressure/velocity field, per-cell character physics or a second body-bearing solver. The native adapter and fallback mirror the bounded operation under their existing serialized owners. The resulting grain may subsequently move under ordinary cellular rules, so the disturbance count is not a promise of permanent crater geometry. Broad generic body↔granular acceptance remains REM-004 / #83. Owner gameplay acceptance of C1 is a separate REM-003 gate and is not implied by automated tests.

Section: Rigid-body and cellular coupling > What does REM-002 establish on Current source?
**Current bounded baseline, 2026-09-24:** [REM-002 evidence](../audits/2026-09-24-rem002-issue11-integration-forensics.md) reconciles the never-integrated historical #11 repair into current main without claiming broad body/granular gameplay acceptance. Current semantics are: - a stored cell beneath a transient body mask remains material authority and does not execute its normal cellular kernel as the body Wall proxy; - ejection endpoints and their bounded path reject hard terrain and foreign body masks; if no legal target exists, the complete payload stays at the source and unresolved overlap is reported; - an ordinary rectangle may receive a bounded cellular-owned granular-bearing contribution from current support-capable packed material; - bearing is recomputed from current cells every accepted sample and disappears after excavation/support loss; there is no support cache or granular Rapier collider; - hard terrain remains Rapier/static-terrain contact, and liquids do not become granular bearing; - the existing 11-float input / 9-float result ABI and sample-age policy remain unchanged. On frozen source `df54e927...`, the focused real-Rapier Linux regression measured one-height Sand peak/final depth **3.748/0.000 cells**, four-height **6.652/1.472 cells**, and explicit excavation released the body into substantial downward travel. The exact runtime/platform qualifications and retained hashes are in the dated REM-002 audit. This is still a bounded ordinary rectangle/load baseline. General shapes, high energy/thin beds, crowding, sustained publication delay, calibrated force/torque, fracture and broad body↔granular gameplay acceptance remain outside this contract and are owned by REM-004 / #83 where applicable.

Section: Native structural detachment > Conservative displacement and the GCR interface
and opposing-velocity handling use the ordinary bridge policy. Conservative displacement introduces no friction, bearing gain or yielding law. Ordinary GCR retains its normal response, friction and granular yielding policy. The independently enabled experiment below adds a supported-Sand normal constraint for this aggregate only; it does not import or promote Y1 #343. Accepted GCR integration needs its own combined-source qualification. Exact material accounting does **not** establish calibrated momentum/energy conservation. This bounded corrective rearrangement is not a bulk granular solver. Fully buried contacts without a nearby admissible vacancy remain unresolved, retain all material, and use the existing contact response. The dedicated worker refuses native-only reset/scenario replacement for its entire session. Reset joins that worker and retires the Rapier body together. A copied native failure latches the session stopped, including mask priming and held-tick waits; unpause cannot bypass the latch. An unexpected native chain quarantine stops preparation before further mask mutation or force publication. Compound feedback admits only forward modular sample identities, preventing a nonconsecutive replay from applying an impulse twice.

Section: Native structural detachment > Conservative displacement and the GCR interface
The strict policy is selected only by diagnostic setup `conservative_displacement=true`; the detachment session selects it by default. It replaces **all** ejection attempts in that session. It never falls back to the permissive ordinary direct relocation. The ordinary body interface remains 11 input / 9 result floats, so GCR need not change its packed protocol. [`conservative_displacement_adapter.inc`](../../godot/native_extension/conservative_displacement_adapter.inc) validates a contact normal, ownership, full cell-square geometry and a bounded vacancy route. [`World::conservative_displace_cells`](../../native/src/world_conservative_displacement.inc) revalidates tick, optional active aggregate lease, every expected tuple, masks, residency, inclusion, policy and thermal capacity before changing any cell. | Rule | Implemented bound / refusal | |---|---| | Path | Two to five distinct positions, at most four cardinal one-cell parcel moves; no cycles. | | Search | Deterministic breadth-first depth four using fixed 81-site scratch; no wider ejection-radius tuning. | | Direction | Each edge has nonnegative projection on the outward normal; the complete path has positive outward progress. | | Parcels | Ambient Sand or ordinary FreeMass Water; no pressure/inertial sidecars, gas, reactive or unsupported material. | | Destination | Full closed unit square has more than `1e-6` cell separation from every current oriented proxy rectangle, and no transient swept/body mask. Exact touch and ambiguous geometry refuse. | | Source | Exact source mask ownership; overlap with a foreign body's square geometry refuses even when first-writer mask sampling hides it. Sibling shapes of the active aggregate share physical ownership. | | Terminal | Canonical ambient Empty, without hidden state or temperature to overwrite. | | Per sample | At most 64 search attempts and 320 touched-coordinate slots. Every source, intermediate and terminal of an accepted path is reserved across repeated preparations of that sample. | | Commit | Shift the vacancy backwards through ordinary `move_cell`, preserving each parcel's material, semantic state and temperature and all dirty/activity/discovery bookkeeping. Scheduling epochs update normally. | There is no allocation in search or admitted chain commit. Resident chunks and any needed thermal fields are preflighted. Expected refusals change no payload. An unexpected commit exception quarantines the World and reports actual partial progress; it is not safe to retry it as an ordinary refusal. **Baseline force/torque ownership (`sand_resistance=false`):** detachment supplies geometry and an ownership lease. The existing cellular coupling supplies exactly one ordinary contact reaction, not one reaction per shifted parcel. The shared Rapier bridge reduces the proxy results to one bounded aggregate correction and applies each existing impulse at its rotated proxy centre, preserving attributable off-centre torque. Duplicate, mixed, incomplete or stale samples refuse before Rapier mutation. Age scaling, correction age

Section: Native structural detachment > Qualification and remaining limits
the independent 2 ms mean-cost criterion is **NOT MET across the full matrix**: 23/24 groups pass. Windows four-worker embedded-Sand baseline r0 costs 2.145915178571 ms per complete consumed observation. All 12 candidate groups pass (worst 1.782429487179 ms). Candidate packed/embedded penetration still reaches 4.046731639982 / 2.642792455422 cells; positive sampled-overlap spans are 5.933745–5.984297 seconds. These unmatched live ranges do not prove causal improvement or continuous unobserved overlap. The unchanged proposed CPU limit and unresolved physical acceptance remain separate from successful CI execution. The focused gates cover exact native geometry, source-pose observation, pure response planning, actual Rapier readback, publication/revision refusal and repeated packed/embedded/mixed sessions. The controlled 12-step mechanism test compares identical loads with the prior three-unit aggregate impulse ceiling offered fully upward on each step. It isolates that ceiling's mechanical limit; it is not a replacement native simulator or a complete B0/Y1 gameplay comparison. Source-bound results and the preserved failed rotating-contact experiment are in the dated ledger. Dense resistance, sustained clearance and rotational behavior remain acceptance questions. The proposed per-observation CPU gate remains separate from GPU pacing and human physical acceptance.

Section: Native structural detachment > Diagnostic scene and controls
Use a freshly built source-matched extension and pinned Godot 4.7/Rapier: ```text godot --path godot res://solid_detachment_lab.tscn ``` | Control | Action | |---|---| | 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 | Reset into dry / packed Sand / partially embedded Sand / mixed Sand–Water surroundings. | | Space | Apply the native support cut and attempt the fenced release. | | P | Pause/resume. | | R | Reset the whole session. | | W | Reset with one or four native workers. | | V | Reset and toggle the explicitly experimental Sand resistance candidate. | | X | Excavate supporting terrain through the native owner. | | I | Request copied conservation/contact inspection. | | Escape | Exit. | The lab consumes immutable material packets and acknowledges only successfully consumed publications. It draws aggregate members from the actual body transform. Terrain edits refresh derived hard collision before another Rapier step. The lab is an inspectable diagnostic, not normal launcher/gameplay acceptance. Start the candidate directly with `godot --path godot res://solid_detachment_lab.tscn -- --sand-resistance`. Omitting the flag keeps the prior contact response selected; observation in the lab is enabled for both choices.

Measurements separate sampled healthy worker/native publications, main-thread consume/publish segments, manual Rapier stepping and collider refresh. Sampled worker totals do not represent every native tick. These headless metrics cannot establish graphical frame pacing or target-GPU acceptance. The complete source-matched Linux/Windows matrix at `8e86ffd4` passed on GitHub-hosted runners, including workers 1 and 4. Its qualified development runtimes and original six-cohort evidence were published in `bdd751dc`. The dated audit records exact identities and preserves the earlier failed Windows checkout attempt. Passing populated cases establish material quantities, aggregate payload, ownership and actual interaction; they do not establish acceptable dense resistance. That historical matrix did not measure live penetration depth or overlap area. The 3 November experiment adds those measurements and local impulse/energy accounting, with its own qualification required. Dry impact produces real rotation and horizontal displacement; a calibrated no-slip rolling criterion is not qualified. Focused native ownership and displacement tests, deterministic frozen contacts, actual Rapier motion/failure/worker-replacement cases, populated environments, excavation and shared response tests are distinct gates. Frozen #338 contacts retain their original source metadata and negative outcomes; four new shallow boundary controls demonstrate accepted relocation, including three multi-parcel paths. No historical result is relabelled as a current execution. The scoped GitHub-hosted workflow authenticates build inputs and every declared Linux/Windows cohort, then reopens their original evidence before publishing the two development runtimes on this draft branch. Publication requires an exact branch-head lease; its commit is a child of the qualified source. Provenance continues to name the original build/execution commit and tree. Raw Windows evidence retains its original line endings. A later metadata commit does not become a newly executed physics source by relabelling the records. Source `5944c130` completed the eight-cohort Linux/Windows matrix and qualified runtime publication `3ac7701`; the [3 November ledger](../audits/2026-11-03-sol281-dense-contact.md) retains its original platform, compiler, cost and physical measurements. Recovery source `2457f5ecb945c60cd5118526f48734e82576ba49`, tree `42b4926b3e15dcbf34b436eff41de50fad54c50a`, passed both builds, eight actual-host cohorts and reduction in [run 41742950418](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/41742950418). Its runtime publication failed on an unchanged correct Linux pointer; no runtime-publication child exists for that run. Its independently calculated 24 cost groups pass the proposed 2 ms gate; sustained clearance remains unresolved. After the bounded publisher repair, final compiled and executed source is `749fb8b597ad866f7535f26442e904207c4f7611`, tree `77a7bc2ed4d1f7ab339dd4a16fd082fccf56f0ce`. Its fresh run is [41746597077](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/41746597077) — **Scoped execution, reduction and runtime publication PASS (all 12 jobs); full-matrix CPU acceptance NOT MET**, with qualified publication child `89d2eb6d280183e495a94b559776dfd8f1cdc196`. The [recovery handover](../audits/2026-11-03-sol281-takeover.md) owns source/runtime receipts, actual measurements and separate gate decisions. Preceding measurements do not qualify this source. Scoped qualification does not establish accepted gameplay physics; metadata/publication children never replace executed identity. For `749fb8b5`,
